panels.label: 旅行拖行
panels.copy_purpose: 机场或旅行空间中的自然拖行展示
panels.scene_prompt_en: Show one adult traveler naturally rolling the exact suitcase with its real telescopic handle extended and all visible wheels grounded.
panels.backdrop_en: Bright refined airport concourse with restrained depth of field.
panels.composition_en: Show the full suitcase, wheels, handle, scale, and ground contact; keep the left side calm.
panels.lighting_en: Clean terminal daylight with realistic hard-shell or textile response.

panels.label: 功能结构
panels.copy_purpose: 完整箱体中突出轮组、拉杆、把手、锁具和拉链细节
panels.scene_prompt_en: Show the exact complete suitcase in a precise detail-led product view, using angle and light to reveal visible wheels, telescopic handle, carry handle, locks, zipper, and corner construction.
panels.composition_en: Keep the full suitcase, every wheel, and the complete visible handle inside frame; keep functional geometry sharp in the upper half and reserve the lower area.
panels.lighting_en: Crisp raking studio light revealing construction.

panels.label: 收纳结构
panels.copy_purpose: 仅在可推断范围内展示开启和收纳结构
panels.scene_prompt_en: Present the exact suitcase in a product demonstration view; show only opening and storage structures supported by the reference, and do not invent interior compartments.
panels.composition_en: Keep exterior identity fully visible and reserve the upper-right.
panels.lighting_en: Soft broad daylight with accurate material color.

panels.label: 旅行场景
panels.copy_purpose: 酒店或交通枢纽中的完整旅行场景
panels.scene_prompt_en: Place the exact upright suitcase in a believable premium travel arrival scene with no other luggage.
panels.backdrop_en: Minimal hotel lobby transition area with sparse architecture.
panels.composition_en: Place the complete suitcase lower-right with a clean upper-left.
panels.lighting_en: Warm arrival light with grounded contact shadows.

panels.label: 产品主视觉
panels.copy_purpose: 完整箱体轮廓与材质广告主视觉
panels.scene_prompt_en: Create a premium hero advertisement of the exact closed suitcase at a natural three-quarter angle, with all wheels and handles accurate.
panels.backdrop_en: Sculptural neutral studio with subtle travel-inspired lines.
panels.composition_en: Center the complete suitcase slightly left and reserve a quiet lower-right.
panels.lighting_en: Controlled campaign lighting with clean silhouette separation.
